rationale:
I read the authenticated originals before relying on them and inspected the ACTUAL revised diff, revised notebook source, patch, controller receipts and synthetic tests, not only the spec prose. This is the v3 round under the operator's expanded item2 scope (a NEW revised 13B copy with synthetic-only CPU checks; original untouched). Unlike v1/v2, which were "proposal correction only; executable not fixed," v3 supplies a bound safe-notebook-patch/v1 that the controller applied to a new copy, scanned, compiled and tested in isolation. I confirmed each carried finding is now genuinely resolved in the real executable call sites.

F-VERDICT-FOLD-MEMBERSHIP (was blocker): The original cell 22 (view 04aeab89..., L562-563) derived HELD from v["held"] and N_ALL=len({c for k in FOLDS_TO_RUN for c in HELD[k]}); L601 missing=[k for k in FOLDS_TO_RUN...]. The patch (cells/22/source, before_sha256 f31eee35..., span 0:11196 matching the view's "cells/22/source bytes 0:11196") replaces this with validate_full_folds enforcing set(held)==range(5), exactly 99 unique members, shuffle 101, one-to-one row membership, rejecting duplicate/missing/extra rows; N_ALL=99 hardcoded; missing computed over range(5); HELD pinned behind FROZEN_PARTITIONS_SHA256 (set to None -> RuntimeError "Item4 hold"), and validate_full_folds is wired into arm_table, other, pair (with how="outer", indicator, len==99 and all "both" check) and the PRIMARY verdict path (diff L246-356). Reduced FOLDS_TO_RUN can no longer yield a non-provisional verdict on fewer than 99 patients.

F-MAGNITUDE-RATIO-GATE (was blocker): Original L636-641/657-662 used a sign gate plus the ratio abs(dd)/y with float('inf') on y==0. The patch removes the ratio/"not distinguishable from retraining" gate and adopts verdict_from_intervals(base_ci,repeat_ci,complete): "better" only when both lower bounds >0, "worse" only when both upper bounds <0, else "no clear difference", refusing malformed/reversed/nonfinite intervals; it requires three distinct fingerprints and run_dirs (candidate/BASE/A1_repeat) and prints the signed repeat-minus-A1 mean as "one unseeded realization; no noise ratio or equivalence inference." train_seed-as-pairing-label is preserved (B L358-359).

F-COVERAGE-PROXY (was suggestion): Original L1447-1484 used all-four-maps-zero (after nan_to_num) as a coverage proxy (cov=brain & ~pref[1]). The patch (cells/8/source, before_sha256 06448d70..., span 0:18421) replaces it with coverage_support(values,brain,coverage=None) returning brain & isfinite(values) (& coverage when supplied) and coverage_known metadata; prep_channel raises RuntimeError "Item4 hold: authenticated perfusion coverage and loader unavailable" for perfusion kinds when coverage is unknown, retains valid zeros, and holds on empty/constant support. COVERAGE_PROVENANCE=None; pnorm_levels raises. zscore_in_brain/histeq_in_brain operate on supplied support with the ZSCORE_MIN_SD floor recorded. These are the real call sites, confirmed by evidence_search at notebook source L925 and diff L190->196.

F-SELF-REVIEW-NOT-OPPOSING (execution authority/provenance): The spec reaches "STOP FOR OPERATOR REVIEW; no execution authority," claims no closure ("only independent APPROVE closes findings"), and the carried execution_conditions.json records HELD_FOR_BACKLOG_ITEM_4 preserving opposing-family review of the full run, baseline/environment receipts, coverage provenance, smoke/recovery and measured timing as item4 preconditions. This independent opposing-family review of the exact executable bytes is the review the earlier finding demanded for this item2 artifact; per the governing task, smoke/timing/environment/coverage provenance "remain item4 preconditions... and not blockers solely for being unexecuted." The missing real-run receipts are therefore correctly preserved, not open blockers on this analysis-only proposal.

Controller receipts verified: provenance shows original_unchanged=true, original_sha256 73f656d5..., view_sha256 04aeab89..., notebook_sha256 9e62bec1...; compile PASS for all 11 code cells; isolation ISOLATED/PASS (no credentials/network/patient mounts, 15 denied paths); synthetic tests PASS for all four groups (fold completeness 99 valid rows/5 folds; verdict rule conjunctive, no_ratio_argument, training_variance_estimated=false; coverage handling nonfinite-excluded, unknown-coverage-not-certified, valid-zero-retained; and the six preserved cell-6 _fx lesion fixtures matching both_empty (1.0,0), truth_only (0.0,1), etc.). The harness extracts the actual AST definitions with no top-level data loading, so the tested helpers are the notebook's real functions, not stubs. The omitted EXCLUDED membership literal (view L801) is externalized to the hash/count-checked private excluded_cases.json (count 1), never supplied here. L469 median epoch 35.69 s, infarct-in-brain min 83%; L470 upper-clipping medians ncct 10%/cbf 8%/cbv 6%/mtt 3%/tmax 12%/cta 10%. Sprint13A aggregates (e5cb1b3e...) The limitations evidence (97f0dce4...) confirms 13A is operator-run aggregates with executed r4 code absent and 13B an unexecuted proposal, and item2 withholds per-patient materials.

The spec answers all eight plan questions (screen-first MODIFY; defer second-window bundle; four primaries with conjunctive verdict and one sensitivity repeat; defer L as whole-preset; defer pnormct; covered-brain statistics replacing the proxy; preserve 13A P1/P2 with no rerun and rejecting unbiased-stacking language; keep SynthStrip conditional on integrity), flags the Sprint12b overlap with the correct same-exposed-patients qualification, costs every option with explicit GPU/CPU/memory rates, overhead, uncertainty and separately-counted scientific model-call estimates, distinguishes estimates from the one measured smoke runtime, challenges scope, preserves reserved-cohort/exploratory limitations and the 25 final-evaluation/24 reserve lock, and reaches a stop-for-operator decision with no patient/GPU/Modal/model-call/dispatch work. No new defect was found in the revised code or synthetic tests. Because all carried findings are resolved in the actual executable, the opposing-family review of the exact bytes has been performed, the controller receipts are valid, and the remaining real-execution conditions are correctly preserved as item4 preconditions rather than open blockers, there are no unresolved findings. Under the bound policy only an independent APPROVE closes these findings, and APPROVE requires findings=[]; that condition is met. The decision is carried by the empty findings set, not this prose.
